lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect has been seen for adoption new screens across 2 completed tests.
Finish redesigns have hurt overall performance (-2.6% after noise correction across 2 completed tests).
Predictions have generally been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Story Screen Visual Carousel Layout
candidates.change: Replaces the default story layout with a visual carousel featuring pet animations to engage users at the start.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and a high mean duration (514s), suggesting early user hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesign retains pet introduction role in story screen.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 23.8% of users with high mean duration; carousel layout may engage early drop-offs.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Restoration Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint below sign-in explaining how account restoration works for returning pet owners.
candidates.why: Support emails show 8 reports of pets missing or reset after users signed in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your original account restores your previously adopted pets automatically.

guard.reason: Sign-in account restoration hint complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has 27.1% drop-off and 8 support reports regarding account restoration; copy fix is cheap and effective.

candidates.title: Sign In Split Authentication Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout separating single-click auth from standard account login.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and support received reports of the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Companion

guard.reason: Split authentication layout maintains sign-in screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel and support stalling reports, though redesigns carry moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Tip Carousel Component
candidates.change: Adds a tip carousel component to the photo upload screen highlighting optimal lighting and camera angles.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 custom pet generation failures and median adoption time is 89 seconds.

components.text: Clear, well-lit photos of your pet front-facing yield the best 3D pet generation results.

guard.reason: Tip carousel component adds photo upload guidance without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 33.8% of users; support reports and long step duration validate adding guidance tips.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Card Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a grid layout featuring archetype choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 33.8% drop-off rate, indicating potential confusion or friction during pet selection.

guard.reason: Grid layout redesign retains friend selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: High impact due to 33.8% drop-off, but evidence for adoption redesigns remains thin.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables time estimates and ready notifications on the waiting screen while background assets build.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), leaving users unsure if pet creation is working.

guard.reason: Progress notifications and real time estimates are permitted on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Extreme wait times at home step; toggle config is low cost and helps manage user expectations.

candidates.title: Desktop System Verification Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a new system check screen during the waiting stage to confirm display and desktop overlay permissions.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 cases where pets failed to show on the desktop or the app failed to launch post-setup.

new_system_check.headline: Verifying Desktop Display
new_system_check.body: Checking screen overlay permissions so your pet can roam freely on your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserting a new system check screen within onboarding flow is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Support reports exist, but lessons show new screens and flows add friction and decrease conversion.

candidates.title: Home Intro System Tray Control Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop system tray shortcuts and hotkeys.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on screen or use the system tray icon to access controls, hide, or interact.

guard.reason: Adding tray control hints to home intro screen complies with onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% and support notes confusion; hint fix avoids redesign penalties at low cost.

candidates.title: Pet Interaction Quick Reference Screen
candidates.change: Adds a quick reference checklist screen at the end of onboarding summarizing key desktop gestures and controls.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails report post-onboarding confusion about desktop pet behavior and control options.

new_interaction_guide.headline: Pet Interaction Quick Guide
new_interaction_guide.body: Quick reference for summoning, hiding, and feeding your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adding a new guide screen following home intro is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addressing support issues is good, but adding a new screen at finish stage historically degrades conversion.

candidates.title: Choose Path Mascot Encouragement Badge
candidates.change: Adds an animated mascot and quick-completion badge to the path selection screen.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users right at the start of onboarding.

guard.reason: Adding mascot and time estimate badge to choose path complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 23.8%; encouraging visual badge adds slight positive motivation.
